categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the internal HTTP server request handling in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Encapsulates the HTTP request state machine by removing HTTPRequest::SetState() and exposing a single Load() method. While this makes internal invariant enforcement a 'compiler-enforced fact' rather than a convention, it is an internal refactoring with no user-visible behavior change or performance impact.
